summary: Dark, text-heavy security page: a hero with four round badges and an email field, a short intro, a long accordion of control groups on black and a logo band before a demo form. Needs four badge-style claims, grouped control texts (14 accordion items) and client logos.

centered heading, then two columns of paragraphs
four group headings centered (compliance, cloud, product, people); under each a stack of full-width rows with a plus icon, 14 rows in all; the first row is open with a text block
heading with one figure and a sentence; 24 client logos in rows of six
